reason: Conversation 1 went straight to the sensible first step: it explained E18 as a drainage code, told the user to unplug before opening the flap, and covered the emergency drain hose and the filter. Conversation 2 had the user run a drain programme with the machine powered on before unplugging, which wastes a step. It also wrongly said the notchy impeller meant something was still caught, and it asked the user to re-plug and re-run when the impeller was fine. It never mentioned the emergency drain hose, though its final outcome was the same.
